parsed.reason: The backoff is computed as timedelta * 2**(consecutive_failures-1) before the min() cap, so a large max_failures (roughly above 47 with a 1s retry_delay) makes the timedelta multiplication raise OverflowError. That exception is raised inside the except handler with no guard, so the RunRecord is never appended and it escapes _run. The exact effect on tick depends on the caller, which isn't shown.
